title: Universal operatorial Noether current associated with a quasi-complete locally convex linear space valued Lagrangian defined on an open set of a product of normed spaces
summary: In the context of locally convex vector valued integrable tensors on open sets of a $n$-dimensional manifold $M$ developped in our previous work \cite{sil09261621}, in this paper we construct a framework in which to address both a variational problem associated with a Lagrangian $\mathscr{L}$, and a conservation law on-shell associated with actions $φ$ and $ω$. $\mathscr{L}$ is a $C^{p}$-map valued in a quasi-complete Hausdorff lcs $\mathcal{Z}$ and defined on an open set $O$ of a normed space, $φ$ is a $C^{p}$-action parametrized by an open $A$ of a normed space $T$, acting over the space…
